name: Klara
short_description: AI agent for therapists that handles clinical notes, treatment plans, insurance claims, and between-session resources across 104 languages.
long_description: Klara is the AI assistant at the heart of Klarify, a Y Combinator Spring 2026 startup building an AI-native operating system for therapists. Klara handles clinical notes in 20+ formats (SOAP, EMDR, CBT, DAP, BIRP), generates treatment plans and clinical letters, prepares insurance claims, develops between-session client resources, and produces visual session mindmaps to identify patterns across care. Supporting 104 languages, Klara is designed to handle administrative work so therapists can focus on clinical care. At launch, Klarify serves 8,300+ therapists across five countries. The platform is HIPAA, PHIPA, Quebec Law 25, and UK GDPR compliant, and is contractually bound not to train AI on clinical data.
one_liner: AI agent for therapists handling notes, treatment plans, and insurance claims in 104 languages.
best_for: Solo therapists and counselors seeking comprehensive AI administrative support
Private practice clinicians wanting to streamline insurance billing
Multi-lingual therapists serving diverse client populations
Clinicians using various therapy modalities (ACT, EMDR, CBT, etc.)
not_for: Addiction treatment centers needing specialized residential features

faqs.q: How much does Klara by Klarify cost?

Yes, Klara is HIPAA, PHIPA, Quebec Law 25, and UK GDPR compliant. Klarify is contractually bound not to train AI on clinical data, and session data is never sold or shared.

faqs.q: What note formats does Klara support?
faqs.a: Klara supports 20+ therapy documentation formats including SOAP, EMDR, CBT, DAP, BIRP, ACT, and more. You tell Klara about the session and specify the modality.

faqs.q: How many languages does Klara support?
faqs.a: Klara supports 104 languages for session transcription and note generation, making it suitable for therapists serving diverse multi-lingual client populations.
